name: studio-app-sidebar
description: Thread rows with project and activity.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Thread details" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Project and activity details on hover.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": { "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderThreadCard" } },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1"],
  "scopes": {},
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
